**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met)** — no redline proposed.

- **Searched**: Article I definitions (incl. "FIELD OF USE"), Article II (License Grant and Restrictions/Additional Restrictions), the fee/commercial articles (V–VII), Article X (Confidential Information/Non-Solicitation), Articles XI–XXIII, and General Provisions; plus targeted searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "develop", and "shall not engage".
- **Result**: There is no non-compete, exclusivity, territory or business-line restraint binding us. The only Licensee-side restrictions are conventional license-scope limits on the Licensor's own Licensed Technology (Field of Use, no sublicense/transfer, no reverse engineering, no Derivative Works), which do not stop us from using, purchasing or building competing FX platforms. The license is expressly non-exclusive with volume-based fees and no minimum or exclusive-routing commitment; Article X restricts only solicitation of Licensor employees.
- **Noted, not flagged**: Article XX (p0134) permits Licensor to withhold change-of-control consent where the acquirer competes with it — an assignment/change-of-control concern handled under that rule, not a restrictive covenant on our operations.
